description_for_human: Browse and purchase AI-inspired streetwear from A-OK Shop (Apes on Keys). Nerd streetwear for AI junkies.
description_for_model: Browse and buy A-OK's AI-inspired streetwear through the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP 2026-04-17). Every color and size has its own item ID in the ACP product feed; tees and hoodies need a size, so ask the shopper rather than guessing. Create a checkout session with item IDs, add a US or Canadian shipping address, then complete it with a Stripe shared payment token, or create a Stripe-hosted checkout page for the shopper to finish.
